name: Sa Pa market
summary: Saturday market in town: walk the evening stalls for textiles, food, and the gathering in the square. Hmong and Dao traders, goods, and a courtship gathering of trading, singing, and talking fill the evening. The same night uses the square in front of the stone church. Go once the stalls are out along the street.
getThere: Walk from the stone church. The market is in town.
heroCaption: Evening stalls of textiles along the street in town
body: Saturday evening is the market in town. You walk the stalls of textiles and food, in the street and under the covered hall. Hmong and Dao traders bring goods, and the evening includes a courtship gathering of trading, singing, and talking.

The square in front of the stone church is part of the same evening. Christmas is marked at the church without a civil date. On other cold nights the grills sit at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down toward the market.

figures.caption: Textiles under the covered market hall
figures.alt: Piles of embroidered textiles in the covered Sa Pa market

gettingThere: The market is in town, a walk from the stone church and the square. Saturday evening is the gathering.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk. The square in front of the church and the market street are the same Saturday evening.
